extensionDescription.message: Routes selected sites through a local proxy and lists which sites are using it.

endpointLabel.message: Local HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy address

autoIntro.message: Start your VPN client. Discovery requires the Windows or macOS helper from the archive.

socksAuth.message: Chrome does not support passwords for SOCKS5. Choose HTTP if available.

found.message: Local ports found. Your VPN client decides where to send their traffic.

notFound.message: No local proxy found. Check that your client is connected or enter the address manually.

permissionDenied.message: Discovery permission was declined. You can still enter the address manually.

helperFailed.message: The helper could not check for local ports.

helperMissing.message: Install the discovery helper for Windows or macOS from the archive, or enter the address manually.

invalidEndpoint.message: Enter a local proxy address, for example http://127.0.0.1:7890.

invalidPort.message: The port must be between 1 and 65535.

proxyControlled.message: Another extension or Chrome policy controls the proxy settings.
